blackboxstrategies-blackbox-strategies:a.title: Account Executive (Remote)
blackboxstrategies-blackbox-strategies:a.description: Location: Remote (Availability during U.S. business hours required) Compensation: Competitive base + performance-based incentives Role: Account Executive About the Role We are seeking an experienced Account Executive to own the full sales cycle—from initial engagement through close—while consistently driving revenue and exceeding performance targets. This is a high-impact role for a self-motivated, results-driven sales professional who thrives in a fast-paced, consultative environment. You will collaborate with leadership and cross-functional teams to engage qualified leads, understand customer needs, and design tailored window treatment solutions, providing expert guidance on best practices. You’ll deliver recommendations that drive measurable results and exceptional customer experiences. Scope of Work - Manage inbound and outbound sales conversations with U.S.-based prospects. - Conduct virtual consultations to assess needs, design custom window treatments, and recommend solutions based on best principles. - Own the sales process end-to-end, including CRM pipeline management. - Provide expert, consultative guidance on window treatment options and design best practices. - Collaborate with internal teams to ensure a seamless post-sale experience. - Consistently meet or exceed agreed-upon performance metrics (conversion rate, activity volume, and revenue). Qualifications - 3+ years in consultative, technical, or high-ticket sales (B2B or B2C). - Proven ability to consistently exceed sales targets. - Exceptional communication skills (spoken and written) in English. - Focused on helping customers, adding value, and acting as a trusted advisor - Background in Interior Design, Architecture, Decoration, or related field preferred. - Proficient in modern CRM platforms and virtual sales tools. - Self-directed with reliable equipment (computer, webcam, headset) and high-speed internet. - Ability to align with U.S. business hours for optimal customer engagement. Compensation We offer a competitive base salary plus performance-based incentives. Exact structure will be aligned with experience, market rates, and the client’s business model. Client-Specific Details - Industry: Home Furnishing - Target Customers: B2C & B2B - Specialized Skills or Knowledge Required: Interior Design, Architecture, Decoration About Us We connect top-tier sales talent with respected U.S. brands, enabling businesses to scale faster through proven sales strategies, modern technology, and operational excellence. Our mission is to provide high-impact opportunities to top-tier talent.

colibrigroup-colibrigroup:lever:23165a57.description: At Colibri Group, culture is a critical part of our collective success, and we live our values everyday: Love, Joy, Boldness, Teamwork, and Curiosity. These values guide our interactions with each other, our customers, and the community. We are currently seeking part-time Real Estate Instructors to instruct inperson and online courses for Colibri Group’s esteemed brand, Superior School of Real Estate. The instructor will use the content and course materials provided to them to teach pre-licensing, continuing education, and post licensing courses. Our instructors help students understand material by leading insightful lessons, providing real-world examples, and answering questions. This is a part-time, employee position with an estimated time commitment of up to 29 hours per week. Classes are scheduled in the mornings, evenings, and weekends, and the length of each class is dictated based on the number of required hours. The instructor is paid an hourly rate based on the number of hours in the class.
responsibilities: Instruct assigned courses according to the course plan

Utilize strong understanding with webinar/livestreaming technology and online instruction
Recommend strategies for success and assist students in meeting course objectives
Participate in faculty curriculum and ad-hoc meetings

farfetchlever-farfetch:lever:13e4bf5d-07.title: Finance Application Specialist
farfetchlever-farfetch:lever:13e4bf5d-07.description: Farfetch is a leading global marketplace for the luxury fashion industry, connecting customers in over 190 countries with items from more than 50 countries and over 1,400 of the world’s best brands and charming boutiques from around the world. Farfetch opens a world of luxury for endless expressions of style, delivering a truly unique shopping experience and access to the most extensive selection of luxury on a global marketplace. FINANCE The Finance team stands as a strategic pillar of our organization, enabling the delivery of our business and financial goals, ensuring robust financial controls and optimizing overall financial performance. Finance is responsible for managing capital, ensuring financial integrity, optimizing resource allocation, and delivering accurate reporting to drive sustainable growth and profitability. PORTO Our office is near Porto, in the north of Portugal, and is located in a vibrant business hub. It offers a dynamic and welcoming environment where our employees can connect and network with a large community of tech professionals. THE ROLE As Finance Application Specialist, you will support the implementation, maintenance and continuous improvement of the company’s financial reporting, planning and consolidation systems. You will be involved in the end-to-end lifecycle of system projects, from design and development to deployment, ensuring data integrity, process optimization, and alignment across global financial modules. Acting as a link between business and technical teams, you will help troubleshoot system issues, manage configurations, and contribute to the delivery of accurate, efficient, and reliable financial data solutions. WHAT YOU'LL DO Support on the implementation of new projects cooperating on all different phases of a project, design, develop and deploy Ensure and maintain data integrity and alignment between the global financial planning and consolidation modules (configuration, test, reconciliation, production vs. quality) Maintenance and administration of SAP BPC, specifically: Dimensions and Models, Teams and Task Profiles, Data Access Profiles and Work Status Interface with technical teams, business and support partner to resolve issues Manage incident, problem, and change management tracking processes Identify, manage and resolve common system issues Identify system processes to optimize, re-design and implement new changes in the system Train End Users as needed on system processes WHO YOU ARE Degree in IT, Business OR similar Previous experience of HFM and/or Hyperion Essbase/Planning or SAP BPC would be an advantage Experience in document processes and procedures Commitment to quality and excellent customer service to end users Capable of successfully multi-tasking while working independently or within a group environment Capable of working well under pressure while dealing with unexpected problems in a professional manner Strong analytical thinking and problem solving skills Fluent in English, both written and spoken is mandatory REWARDS & BENEFITS Employee Pension Scheme Flexible Benefits Program Health Insurance & Critical Illness cover Flexible work environment- Hybrid Model (3 days a week from the office, 2 days from home) EQUAL OPPORTUNITIES STATEMENT FARFETCH is committed to being an inclusive workplace where diversity in all its forms is celebrated. We make employment decisions without regard to race, religious creed, color, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, ancestry, marital status, medical condition as defined by state law, physical or mental disability, military service or veteran status, pregnancy, childbirth and related medical conditions, genetic information or any other classification protected by applicable federal, state or local laws or ordinances. If you require special accommodation, please let us know. SCAM DISCLAIMER

foundersfactory-founders-factory:ashbyhq.title: Venture Builder (HealthTech)
foundersfactory-founders-factory:ashbyhq.description: 👋 HEY, WE'RE FOUNDERS FACTORY Founders Factory builds and funds startups together with exceptional entrepreneurs and the world's leading companies. Headquartered in London and operating globally, Founders Factory backs visionary founders with capital, dedicated support from a team of expert operators, and unrivalled access to a coalition of industry leading corporate partners. Since 2015, FF has backed 450+ portfolio companies helping them to secure over 500 enterprise pilots with blue chip corporate partners such as Aviva, Northwestern Medicine, Johnson & Johnson Innovation, and HSBC. The Opportunity: Health systems globally are burdened by capacity constraints, rising chronic disease, aging populations, and escalating operational costs. Care delivery models built around physical hospitals are increasingly unsustainable. Advances in connected devices, remote diagnostics, and AI-enabled monitoring now make it possible to safely move large parts of care beyond hospital walls while improving outcomes and patient experience. The big promise of technology in this space is to enable continuous, proactive, and lower cost care particularly across long-term condition management or home-based / community care while allowing scarce clinical resources to focus where they matter most. We are looking for exceptional Venture Builders who are passionate about building the future of healthcare delivery. 🔍 WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR? As a Venture Builder, you specialise in taking ideas from zero to venture-backable businesses. You work closely with founders to shape strategy, validate problem spaces, build MVPs, and find early product market fit. This is a hands on, high ownership role. You’ll operate across product, design, growth and tech, moving fast, making decisions, and focusing relentlessly on what creates the most leverage at each stage of a venture. You have a varied skill set and will have demonstrated an interest in tech and entrepreneurship. You will be an advocate for FF’s values and mission and be committed to supporting founders. You are opinionated but evidence led, creative but commercial, and comfortable operating in ambiguity. You care deeply about building products people actually want and businesses that can scale. Please note that we are looking for Venture Builders who are available for an initial 6-12 month contract (freelance). Our preferred location is New York, but we will be open to considering hybrid approaches for exceptional talent in Austin, Boston or Denver. 💪 YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES: - Owning the end-to-end early build: from problem definition and MVP scoping through to shipping, testing, and iteration - Getting products into users hands fast, using lean, experimental approaches to validate assumptions and generate learning - Shaping the customer experience and product vision, balancing user needs with commercial and technical realities - Working closely with founders to challenge thinking, sharpen focus, and drive momentum, especially when things feel unclear or uncomfortable - Helping ventures progress through studio stage gates, supporting founders towards strong, evidence-backed IC decisions - Spotting opportunities early by staying close to market dynamics, emerging tech, and real user behaviour - Communicating clearly and regularly, sharing progress, learnings, trade-offs, and recommendations with founders and the wider studio 🎯 REQUIRED SKILLS, EXPERIENCE AND MINDSET: - Demonstrated 0→1 experience in digital health or medtech, whether at a startup, through a side project, research, or volunteering (experience applying AI or developing innovative health/medical devices are considered highly advantageous). - Driving momentum by subscribing to lean methodologies and an experimental approach, you prioritise speed, learning, and focus over perfection - Comfortable wearing multiple hats (product, design, tech, growth) and knowing when to pull in specialist support - Strong technical mindset, with the ability to bui

jobgether-jobgether:lever:0fd6d759-9b22-.title: Territory Account Manager
jobgether-jobgether:lever:0fd6d759-9b22-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Territory Account Manager based in Canada. This is an opportunity to drive growth across a portfolio of commercial accounts in Ontario within a fast-moving technology sales environment. You will act as a trusted advisor to customers, uncovering business challenges and positioning sophisticated networking and data center solutions. The role combines strategic account management, consultative selling, new business development, and relationship building. You’ll work closely with technical specialists, channel partners, and internal teams to develop compelling solutions and deliver measurable customer value. Success will require a strong understanding of modern networking technologies and the ability to engage stakeholders from technical teams through C-level decision-makers. This is a high-impact role for an experienced sales professional who thrives on ownership, competition, and building long-term customer relationships. Own sales performance across a named portfolio of approximately 30–40 commercial accounts throughout Ontario, consistently working to exceed measurable sales targets. Develop and execute consultative sales strategies that address customer needs across hybrid cloud, legacy IT modernization, networking, data center, campus, Wi-Fi, monitoring, detection, and security environments. Build trusted relationships with key influencers, technical stakeholders, decision-makers, and C-level executives, clearly communicating the business value of proposed solutions. Partner with systems engineers and technical resources to design, position, and present solutions that address customer requirements while improving performance and reducing total cost of ownership. Identify and develop new business opportunities while expanding relationships and revenue within existing accounts. Establish and manage productive relationships with technology partners and channel organizations to generate opportunities and deliver integrated solutions. Create strategic and tactical account plans informed by regular business reviews with prospects and customers. Lead demand-generation activities, including customer events, technology forums, lunch-and-learns, and other initiatives that create engagement and pipeline. Collaborate with sales and marketing colleagues to share best practices, coordinate territory initiatives, and strengthen customer engagement. Monitor technology trends, partner offerings, competitive solutions, and market developments to continuously refine sales strategies. Requirements: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and experience, with at least 5 years of technology sales experience. Demonstrated success selling directly to commercial accounts within a defined territory and consistently achieving or exceeding sales targets. Relevant experience in data center or networking technologies, gained through a technology vendor, competitor, channel partner, or end-user organization. Established relationships and a strong professional network within the Ontario territory, particularly in the Greater Toronto Area. Proven ability to prospect, develop new accounts, expand existing customer relationships, and operate with a strong hunter mentality. Strong technical understanding and sales experience in one or more areas such as networking, SDN, NFV, switching, network automation, routing, data centers, edge computing, network virtualization, hyper-converged infrastructure, or cloud computing. Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build credibility and influence stakeholders at multiple organizational levels. Strong consultative selling and negotiation abilities, combined with the confidence to act as a trusted advisor. Ability to collaborate effectively with technical teams, partners, sales colleagues, and senior customer stakeholders. A proactive, results-or

qualdoc-qualdoc:lever:34977bdb-d4ea-4d15.title: CNC Milling & Programming Machinist
qualdoc-qualdoc:lever:34977bdb-d4ea-4d15.description: Precision CNC Mill Machinist Location: Baltimore, MD Employment Type: Contract-to-Hire Starting Pay: From $28.00 per hour, with higher pay available depending on experience. Position Overview We are looking for an experienced Precision CNC Mill Machinist to support the production of high-quality components used in industrial, marine, heavy equipment, and energy applications. This position is responsible for machine setup, CNC operation, program editing, part inspection, and continuous process improvement within a fast-paced job shop environment. The ideal candidate has strong machining knowledge, enjoys solving production challenges, and is committed to producing precision parts that meet strict quality standards.
responsibilities: Perform complete setups on multi-axis CNC vertical and horizontal milling machines .
Read and interpret blueprints, work orders, machining drawings, and manufacturing instructions.
Machine precision components to tolerances of approximately ±.002" .
Inspect finished parts using standard measuring and inspection equipment.
Edit existing CNC programs and create new CNC programs to improve production.
Develop, maintain, and improve fixtures and workholding for production parts.
Work with the Production Manager to develop tooling, fixtures, dies, and manufacturing processes.
Perform machining operations including milling, turning, drilling, grinding, shaping, and hand-tool work as needed.
Troubleshoot machining, tooling, and setup issues independently.
Perform routine machine maintenance and maintain a clean, safe work environment.
Meet production schedules while working with minimal supervision.
qualifications: Experience setting up and operating multi-axis CNC milling equipment.
Ability to read and interpret blueprints and machining documentation.
3+ years of experience editing and creating CNC programs preferred.
4-5 years of experience developing production fixtures preferred.
Experience using SolidWorks CAM PRO preferred.
Strong knowledge of machining practices, tooling selection, feeds, speeds, and setup procedures.
Experience machining aluminum, stainless steel, and carbon steel .
Ability to inspect precision components using standard measuring equipment.
Strong troubleshooting, problem-solving, and organizational skills.

summitwashholdings-summitwashholdings:le.title: Full Service Team Member
summitwashholdings-summitwashholdings:le.description: IMPORTANT - REQUIRED NEXT STEP As part of our hiring process, all applicants are required to complete the Predictive Index (PI) Behavioral Assessment. The PI Behavioral Assessment is not a test, and there are no right or wrong answers. It helps us better understand your natural workplace preferences and behaviors. Please complete the assessment when prompted. Completion is required for your application to move forward in the review process. Benefits, and Perks - Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance - Career Growth based on Performance and not Seniority – 75% of employees were promoted within Summit Wash Holding - Referral Bonus up to $800.00 per qualified hire, dependent on position - Free Car Wash Membership - 401k Who are we? Summit Wash Holdings is a premier group of car wash brands growing throughout the Northeast, Midwest, and Southeast regions. At Summit Wash Holdings, all teammates produce speedy service in a fun and mutually respectful manner with gold-standard integrity, quality, and hospitality, all while maintaining a work-life balance. Our Mission is to provide a fast, quality car wash with friendly-spirited engagement and integrity. Summit Wash Holdings shares the mission to consistently create memorable experiences, living by the mantra “One Wash, One Way.” Guided by the vision to set the industry standard where professional execution meets personal fulfillment, our company is built on a foundation of values that inspire excellence. What do we need? We seek high-energy personalities that thrive in a fast-paced environment to provide a welcoming atmosphere for our Unlimited Wash Pass Members and a memorable first impression on our new car wash guests. A successful candidate would love working outdoors in all conditions and will be confident in getting dirty to get the job done! You must be highly motivated, have an outgoing, friendly personality, and have excellent communication skills - bilingual a plus! All we ask is for you to share our passion for washing cars, creating memorable moments, and our obsession with exceptional guest service! Location: Speeders Car Wash (Danbury 2) 85 Newtown Road. Danbury, CT 06810
